subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “An orchestra streamed its concerts online.”?
options: Another passenger heard this and shared a story about a bird that flew home from far away.
The online page allowed people far away to join.
People who lived far away or could not afford tickets could listen at home.
This helped people who lived far away or could not leave home easily.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Another passenger heard this and shared a story about a bird that flew home from far away.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The online page allowed people far away to join.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「People who lived far away or could not afford tickets could listen at home.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「This helped people who lived far away or could not leave home easily.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「People who lived far away or could not afford tickets could listen at home.」，答案為「People who lived far away or could not afford tickets could listen at home.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「People who lived far away or could not afford tickets could listen at home.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
